note: Trick-1 silver set (docs/m3-hybrid/silver.md; owner, 2026-10-17): 400 trick-1 decisions of the yardstick's generator (seed 1, as the golden sets: 52 at each of seats 1-4, 48 at each of seats 5-8, a quarter per stratum) x 320 worlds (seed 1, label 1: the golden sets' streams), every candidate valued by H_3 (exact search through tricks 1 and 2, the adopted O_3 f5766aa9, 2048-1024-256, at the start of trick 3): silver-t1-c3-n320.jsonl, records `hybrid` with the network's SHA-256, never an exact golden set; resumable world by world (checkpoint uploaded every 5 minutes). Priced in docs/m3-hybrid/silver.md section 5 from the build VM's pilot: about 42-81 hours and $42-82 on an AMD EPYC 9654 (368 usable threads, $1.01/h) at 400 x 320; launch with a dollar cap.
